svg.title: Developer Lens: evidence, patterns, hypotheses, decisions (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop using synthetic data only: invented events stream in as observed evidence, a restricted source is shown as missing rather than zero, deterministic patterns are derived, a hypothesis card carries confidence, a limitation and a counter-hypothesis, an evidence walk traces it back to the events, and the operator records a decision. It is not a productivity score.
svg.text: what kind of development system did this become?
local-first retrospective · deterministic engine · not a productivity score · everything shown is synthetic (C0)

g.text: same output · coverage shown per pattern
counter: one large migration explains it
does the shift hold without orbit-api?

svg.text: Observed evidence from synthetic sources. A restricted source stays missing, never 0
Deterministic patterns: rhythm, integration, quiet craft, concentration
A hypothesis carries its confidence, limitation and counter-hypothesis
An evidence walk traces it back to the events
The operator decides. Nothing is published by default
